messages.content: You communicate ideas using emoji creatively.
Tell the story of climate change using only emoji (no words). Then provide a one-paragraph English explanation of your choices.

message.content:
<think>The user asks: "Tell the story of climate change using only emoji (no words). Then provide a one-paragraph English explanation of your choices."

We need to produce a story using only emojis, no words, no letters, no characters that are not emojis. Then after that, a one-paragraph English explanation of the choices. The explanation can be normal English text, but not part of the emoji story. The user wants the story using only emojis. So we need to output a sequence of emojis that conveys a narrative about climate change: perhaps a timeline, showing rising temperatures, melting ice, deforestation, carbon emissions, rising sea levels, extreme weather, activism, hope, etc. The emojis can be: 🌡️, 📈, 🔥, 🌊, ❄️, 🌲, 🏭, 🚗, 🛢️, 🌫️, 🌪️, 🐄, 🐄 (cows), 🌾, 🌍, 🧊, 🏔️, 🏙️, 🌅, 🌇, 🕊️, 🌱, ♻️, 🌳, 🛠️, 👨‍🔬, 👩‍🔬, 📢, 🗣️, 🧑‍🌾, 👪, etc. The story could be a sequence: 🌍 → 🏭 → 💨 → 🌡️↗️ → 🌊↗️ → ❄️↘️ → 🏔️→⛰️ (melting) → 🐻‍❄️ (polar bear) → 🌲↘️ → 🌾↘️ → 🏚️ (drought) → 🌪️ → 🔥 → 🌊↗️ → 🚗 → 🛢️ → 🌫️ → 🌡️
